pages.text: The gem is beautiful, but its color is not what caught my attention. Something within it seems to answer the light. I cannot explain the sensation, though I find myself imagining how it might look if cut with greater precision.

A dedicated $(item)Gem Cutter$() would need to hold a gem securely and present a selection of deliberate cuts. I have not yet settled its exact construction materials, so I will leave the schematic unfinished for now.
pages.title: A Cutter in Mind
